盟.meaning: Two rival cooks, one who works by day and one by night, have to share one <part>dish</part> under a <part>bright</part> lamp in a tiny kitchen. The day cook bakes the base, the night cook adds the topping, and they sign a deal on the plate's rim in tomato sauce. The town's best pie comes from their <kanji>alliance</kanji>.
盟.on: They celebrate by getting lost together in a hedge <sound>ma</sound>ze.

偶.meaning: A man in a sweet shop hangs his coat on what he thinks is a <part>coat hook</part>. It's the handle of the <part>gumball machine</part>. The handle turns, and a hundred gumballs pour out across the floor. Shoppers slip, kids cheer, and he swears he did it <kanji>accidentally</kanji>.
偶.on: One gumball squashes into a blob of sticky <sound>goo</sound> on his shoe.
偶.kun: A girl finds a <sound>ta</sound>co-flavoured one and saves it for her <sound>ma</sound>ma: a rare treat, once in a while.

挑.meaning: A fortune teller cracks a shell, and the <part>portent</part> says a storm will sink any ship that sails today. A stubborn old sailor hauls up his <part>anchor</part>, rows straight out into the waves and shouts at the clouds, 'Come on, then!' He never refuses a <kanji>challenge</kanji>.
挑.on: On the shore, the fortune teller tugs at her <sound>cho</sound>ker and refuses to watch.
挑.kun: He packs an <sound>ee</sound>l sandwich and a <sound>do</sound>lphin-shaped float, as if it's a picnic.

促.meaning: A lazy ghost hangs on a <part>coat hook</part> all day, pretending to be a cloak. Its landlady gives it a nudge with her <part>foot</part>, then another, then a firm tap: 'Go and haunt something!' She knows how to <kanji>stimulate</kanji> even the sleepiest tenant.
促.on: Next morning she wakes it by waving a smelly <sound>sock</sound> under the hood.
促.kun: When that fails, she lures it out with <sound>u</sound>don, <sound>na</sound>an and <sound>ga</sound>rlic bread.

超.meaning: Halfway through a marathon, a <part>runner</part> hears a <part>call</part> from somewhere above the clouds. She keeps going: up a hill, past the finish line, up the sky itself, and jogs round the moon, waving. She didn't just win the race; she managed to <kanji>transcend</kanji> it.
超.on: Her medal floats after her on a sparkly <sound>cho</sound>ker.
超.kun: A sleepy <sound>ko</sound>ala on a cloud opens one eye as she jogs past.

軸.meaning: A stunt driver spins his <part>car</part> in circles round a single bollard for an hour. When reporters ask the <part>reason</part>, he points at the bollard: 'Something has to stay still while everything else goes round.' That bollard is his <kanji>axis</kanji>.
軸.on: A <sound>jee</sound>p full of <sound>coo</sound>ks parks beside it to sell him hot dogs.

拒.meaning: Pirates sail toward a peaceful island, but a <part>giant</part> is paddling in the shallows. Each time they drop their <part>anchor</part>, he plucks it up and flicks it back aboard like a pebble. After the tenth try they turn round and leave. He can <kanji>repel</kanji> any ship.
拒.on: Then he buys an ice lolly from the beach <sound>kio</sound>sk.
拒.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala on his shoulder blows a <sound>bu</sound>bble at the pirates as they go.
